name: Elevation sample map
task: T-194 (from the MVP map, T-096, with rooftops at heights 3 and 6 and parking-garage ramps)
units: 1 unit = the car's width; the car is drawn 1 x 3 units
origin: x and y in units from the map's centre, x to the right, y down; rectangles give their top-left corner
centre_line: each challenge's centre_line is its arrow points drawn as in the sketches' pictures: quadratic curves through the midpoints between points, straight ends
challenge_designs_note: the fitted challenge designs in units from the pattern's centre, rotation 0; the map places them during a run for the kaiju's meteor challenges (T-035)
elevation_note: Height data (platforms, ramps) in the format of game/README.md, 'Elevation sample map', 'Height data'; checked with game/tools/check_height_data.py. Every rooftop and ramp is a proposal for the board's playtest. Left out from the MVP map: 4 buildings under rooftops, 8 boulders on rooftops, ramps or in front of a ramp's foot, 4 pattern copies left with no boulder and 1 challenges whose copy lost a boulder.
